nvim/lua.candidate: JSON null decoded as Lua nil (luanil)
Debounce timer stopped and recreated on each trigger
Missing tool/version in a report defaulted to gradebook-<tool> and ''
Lists in options replace defaults; resolve does not leak between calls
Severity buckets match the tools' FLAG_ORDER buckets (drift guard)
VS Code config test listed as existing test

nvim/makefile.candidate: `make help` lists the Makefile targets with their descriptions
`make deps` shallow-clones plenary.nvim into .deps/ only when it is not already there
`make test` runs the plugin specs headless, one after another, with plenary and tests/minimal_init.lua
`make smoke` runs the plugin headless with --clean against the real gradebook CLIs

`make lint` loads every Lua file under lua/, plugin/ and tests/ and prints FAIL for each one that writes output. It always ends by printing "ok" and exits 0 even when files failed, so it cannot fail a build (questionable: a gate that cannot fail)
The NVIM and PLENARY variables can be overridden to pick the editor binary and where plenary is kept

nvim/plugin.candidate: The plugin loads once per session (vim.g.loaded_gradebook guard prevents double registration)
Command descriptions shown in :command listing ('Scan the project with gradebook', 'Show the gradebook score report')
Scan does nothing when the plugin is disabled or no tools are selected
nvim/plugin.covered_by: owned by the nvim/gradebook core module (settings / tool-selection), not this plugin entry file

vscode/esbuild.candidate: The extension sources are bundled from src/extension.ts into a single out/extension.js (CommonJS, node platform)
The 'vscode' module is left external so the editor supplies it at runtime
The bundle targets node18 so it parses on the VS Code 1.85 floor
Release builds are minified with no sourcemap; --watch builds are unminified with inline sourcemaps
--watch keeps rebuilding on source changes instead of building once

vscode/server.candidate: Last report kept per project and tool; invalidate clears it and replies cached: 0
Cancel request with no target replies cancelling: false
scanProject without a root fails with the bare error "'root'"
Fatal startup line {id:0, ok:false, fatal:true} when the server cannot be built
--code/--tests/--root flags and GRADEBOOK_*_MODULE / GRADEBOOK_ROOT environment variables
Repository root guard for a shallow install path
stdin read on a background thread for Windows pipes
Replies carry the request id and ok: true
Server shuts down when stdin closes
The scan server says it is ready before anything is asked of it
A ping reports the protocol, the Python version, each tool's version and location, and the severity of every kind of finding
A ping still answers when tools are missing, and names the ones it cannot run
A bad request fails on its own and the session carries on
Cancelling a running scan does not stop its report from arriving
A project scan returns the tool's full report with its top recommendations
Scanning something that is not a directory is refused
A scan with a tool that cannot be loaded explains how to install it
One missing tool does not stop the other from scanning
A tool that failed to load stays unavailable until the server restarts

vscode/src.candidate: Splitting the server's stdout stream into whole JSON lines across chunks
Unparseable server lines are logged and ignored
Trace setting logs every request (->) and reply (<-) truncated to 400 chars
Server stderr is copied to the output log prefixed "server:"
Store keeps one report per tool and notifies listeners
Findings grouped by absolute path for one update per file
Group ids carry a generation counter so expand state is re-read
Per-setting defaults (python3, empty tool paths, exclude [], failUnder 0)
Show Output command opens the gradebook log
Report view opens beside the editor and updates while open
Filter quick pick shows a count per severity and tool
The panel can be narrowed by severity and tool, and an empty pick shows everything
Clearing the filter brings every finding back
Choosing a finding on a real file opens that file at its line
Expand all opens every group, even after the developer collapsed them
Cancelling a scan drops its answers and is reported as "cancelled"
Restarting the server, or changing the interpreter or tool paths, starts a fresh server

vscode/src.rule: Text from a scanned repository is shown as text in the report, never run as markup
